name: Ammeter
summary: An ammeter indicates current from a direct or instrument-transformed measurement circuit.
description: An ammeter indicates current from a direct or instrument-transformed measurement circuit. Its schematic must identify the actual current path and any CT secondary circuit.
readingNotes: Distinguish the meter's current measurement terminals from its auxiliary supply.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An ammeter is an indication device, not an overcurrent protective function.
